# Black Lab Deals

Black Lab Deals is currently a static site shell. Public shopping feeds, cached item data, generated item pages, item cards, item images, and item refresh automation have been removed.

## Public pages

- https://blacklabdeals.com/ - Site shell and cleanup notice.
- https://blacklabdeals.com/about/ - About the site.
- https://blacklabdeals.com/categories/ - Cleanup status page.

## Current status

The repository no longer publishes public item feeds or generated shopping pages. The remaining site preserves basic navigation, brand assets, crawler access, sitemap structure, and the subscriber endpoint.
